post.text:
i got chatgpt atlas (@OpenAI's web browser) so you don’t have to

here's what i found interesting in 15 mins:

1️⃣ agent mode is sick. it completes things like ordering coffee or filling out a tsa precheck forms on my browser with my passwords

2️⃣ when you background a tab with agent (which is really amazing they built that) it gets tripped up in content blockers

3️⃣ websites like @nytimes somehow blocked using atlas to summarizing content. @CNN  and others work just fine

4️⃣ it’s so native to MacOS and is integrated with auto-filling iMessage 2fa codes which is super sick. chrome doesn’t even do this

5️⃣ the agent is very human like (example: dismissed modals by clicking out from them). maybe it’s not intentional and got lucky? not sure

6️⃣ i love the ui and onboarding is super slick. very clever use of full-screen usage on my mac. the animations are fucking amazing.

watch the video for 15 minutes of my raw thoughts and first look
